title: Program Lines from Area and Security Lighting Rental and the Late Charge on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
Area and Security Lighting Rental bills its rentals and charges on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account as program charge lines. In figuring the late-charged amount of the most recent bill, area light lines of that bill are left out as follows:

| The bill carries | Left out of the late-charged amount |
|---|---|
| One or more area light rental lines | The area light rental lines |
| No area light rental line, but one or more area light charge lines | The area light charge lines |
| No area light line of either kind | Nothing |

The lines left out are taken off the bill's usage and program charge lines in figuring the late-charged amount, which is never less than zero.

### Hypothetical bills

| Area light rental lines | Area light charge lines | Left out |
|---|---|---|
| $14.50 | None | $14.50 |
| $14.50 | $22.00 | $14.50 — the rental lines are left out and the charge line stays in |
| None | $22.00 | $22.00 |
| None | None | $0.00 |

### Points of reading

- The bill's lines are the lines dated less than one whole month before the current date.
- Where a bill carries both kinds of line, only the rental lines are left out.
